headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested matchup, while the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians, securing a 13-6 win. The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, ending their opponent's chances.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Ben Williamson, a second baseman for the Tampa Bay Rays, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. He will miss at least the next 10 days. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox), Joey Bart (Chicago White Sox), Luis Urías (Toronto Blue Jays), and Luinder Avila (Kansas City Royals).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, with the Kansas City Royals acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.
